scripts.zip: tar cfz base-extension.tar.gz build/* package.json package-lock.json README.md icon.png
scripts.build: npm run test && rm -rf ./build && npm run transpile && npm run build:copy:assets && node ./build/index.js && npm run zip
scripts.build-notest: rm -rf ./build && npm run transpile && npm run build:copy:assets && node ./build/index.js && npm run zip
scripts.build-windows: npm run test && del /f /s /q build && npm run transpile && node ./build/index.js && npm run zip
